text_helper: Table 56. WWDG min/max timeout value at 48 MHz (PCLK) — section 6.3.18 Timer characteristics. Prescaler, WDGTB, Min timeout value, Max timeout value, Unit.

notes: 1. Data based on characterization results, not tested in production.
